body:
## Change

F1. Apply existing prompt-card identity policy before formatting effect descriptions. Hidden card names/codes must not leak through message text after contextCard redaction.
F2. Regression exercises production prompt boundary with hidden opponent context; parent inspected formatter/redactor path.

## Validation

V1. Behavioral red/green captured; parent reran 35 prompt tests. Worker related suite: 44 tests; boundaries: 52. Typecheck, targeted lint/format and diff checks pass.

## Limits

L1. Exact hidden-card combination not reproduced from a native engine duel. Direct production protocol-boundary fixture validates concealment contract; no claim of a demonstrated live duel leak. Full repository/browser suites not run locally; CI separate.
title: fix(protocol): prevent hidden effect card identity leaks
